description: Frans Halsbuurt 1877-1881 (Eerste Jacob van Campenstraat, Saenredamstraat, Quellijnstraat, Govert Flinckstraat west): 4-7 m fronts of a ground storey and four low upper storeys (2.3-2.4 m) of dark red-brown brick under a thin white cornice at about 13 m; two axes on fronts under 4.9 m, three above; white T-windows under segmental brick heads with a small white keystone; white sills; one white pediment or pointed dormer with a hoist beam over the middle

match.note: Stalpertstraat 38-70 (1878-79), Saenredamstraat 1-37 and 26-56 (1878-80), Quellijnstraat 35-61 (1879): cornice 12.8-13.2 m on the 2016-2023 strips; 3DBAG 5 bouwlagen, eaves 12.3-14.5 m (the dormers); the strip skyline reads the dormer at 14.5-16 m (frontSkylineM)

pediment-dormer.note: Stalpertstraat 38-70: one white dormer about 1.6 m wide over the middle, 13.2-15.0 m, pediment or pointed cap and a hoist beam

door-left.note: house door on the left axis; a pand whose door reads on the right is mirrored (mirrorForDoor), so a two-axis front keeps a valid door bay

rhythm.bays: 2 axes under 4.9 m, else 3 equal axes
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: door + window or shop | 1-4: 2 or 3
rhythm.groundFloor: house door and window, or a shop
rhythm.roofline: thin white cornice at 13 m, one dormer with a hoist beam
schemaLimits: the pointed (bell) dormer caps of Stalpertstraat are drawn as pediments
